verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an official MCP server that users add to their own AI assistant, with OAuth login and workspace selection, plus scoped service keys for agent automation. This lets users drive the workspace in natural language through an external assistant. Fieldwork's 'Describe your control' flow, where AI agents collect evidence, adds a narrow natural-language entry point. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which operations the MCP tools can perform, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
